name: Yamaha RD250LC / RD350LC
engine: 247 or 347 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke parallel twin, Autolube
intro: The liquid-cooled RD twins sold in Europe, Canada and elsewhere. The 350LC led to the RZ350 in the US.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
